name: Exploring the Alliance
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, you are back.I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 2,555 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: Exploring the Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions.
